_comment: Made by packages/protocol/scripts/gen-bridge-attest-vectors.ts from fixed TEST seeds (never real keys). Read by packages/protocol/test/bridge-attest.test.ts (under Node and Bun) and the iPhone app (TalosRelayCore). Every case is checked with nonce, origin and relay_id below; body_hex is the answer as received (body, when present, is the same as text); verdicts are pass, repin (new_fp) or fail (reason). k2 is the bridge key that signs; k0 -> k1 -> k2 are its rotations.

cases.name: the pinned key signs: pass
at pairing, the QR key signs: pass
a chain from the pinned key to the signing key: repin
the same valid chain at pairing: fail
a chain that starts before the pinned key: skip to it, repin
a chain that starts after the pinned key
a chain with a gap (it ends before the signing key)
a chain that repeats a key
a chain of 9 entries (7 skipped before the pinned key, then a good walk): the cap
the pinned key signs and the chain has 9 entries: the cap holds whoever signs
the pinned key signs: a chain that is not walked is not read
an invalid entry before the pinned key is skipped, not read: repin
a 31-byte key inside the walked chain
a certificate for another relay
a certificate signed by the new key, not the old
someone else's key with a chain that does not start at the pinned key
another key and no chain
a pinned fp whose last character is not canonical

signed over another origin
signed over another fp
signed under another tag
one signature bit flipped
a short signature
a non-canonical S (S + L): Node, Bun and CryptoKit all refuse it; the check refuses S >= L itself too
a 31-byte key
a 33-byte key
a key whose last character is not canonical
not JSON
a JSON array

the chain as an object

the same with 2-byte characters, under 8192 bytes: pass
